summary: Rogers Corp (NYSE:ROG) filed an 8-K reporting the permanent appointment of Ali El-Haj as President, CEO, and Board member, effective May 19, 2026, after serving as interim CEO since July 2025. The appointment followed an executive search; no forced departure or abrupt change was disclosed. Compensation includes $750k base salary, 100% target annual incentive, and $5M in long-term incentive equity (time- and performance-based RSUs). This is a routine appointment of a previously interim CEO as permanent, not a disruptive departure. The filing does not involve any transaction, tender, or special situation beyond management succession; watch for any future strategic shifts under new leadership.
